Jordan L.: Quick ops Q 1%: IC moving teams next month and manager wants to both transfer org and give a promotion + 10% comp bump effective on the transfer date. How do we handle proration, backpay if promotion approved earlier, and benefits eligibility?

Maya P.: manager here. Were trying to avoid double paperwork. Can we make the promotion effective the transfer date so it shows on the new team's PE cycle?

Evan R.: TL;DR: promotion + transfer is allowed but needs two records: Transfer form and Promotion packet. Details: 
- Promotion must have evidence and go through calibration; you can request an effective date on the promotion packet (e.g., transfer start).
- If promotion is approved after transfer date, comp team may apply retro pay to align to requested effective date (subject to payroll cutoff & Retro Approval).

Jordan L.: proration question: if the promo bump is effective mid-pay-period, do we prorate salary for that pay run?

comp-ops-bot: Payroll rules: salary changes effective on any date are prorated for that pay period. Payroll runs on 1st and 15th; submit changes by EOD 3 business days before run for that cycle. Retro pay calculated in next payroll run if Retro Approval not required. See https://intranet/payroll/processes

Maya P.: benefits impact: does transfer reset benefits waiting periods or change holiday accrual? Person keeps continuous service but some benefits change by country/team.

benefits-bot: Benefits note: continuous service preserved for tenure-based benefits. Local benefit enrollments depend on the receiving team's location. If transfer changes region or full-time equivalency (FTE), benefits admin will auto-trigger enrollment changes. Allow 5 business days for admin.

Jordan L.: what if the manager wants to fast-track promo decision to avoid retro? Is there an expedited option?

Evan R.: yes 1: request an expedited calibration by emailing people-ops-leads with subject `EXPEDITE: Promotion - <EMPNAME>` and attach Promotion packet + manager attestations. Expedited reviews require strong evidence and typically 2 business day turnaround if available. Still need comp sign-off.

Maya P.: equity: if promotion changes band, does equity target change immediately or wait for refresh cycle?

Evan R.: equity adjustments can be applied with promotion if compensation approves and equity ops prepares grant. Ad-hoc grants above band thresholds require exec approval. If equity refresh cycle is next quarter and promo approved now, comp team can do an out-of-cycle grant; expect 3 business days for processing and Legal review if international.

Jordan L.: recordkeeping: do we keep both transfer and promotion docs even if effective same date?

Evan R.: yes 1: keep both. Promotion record should reference Transfer ID and effective date. CompChange entries should include `effective_date` and `requested_effective_date` fields for audit.

Maya P.: last Q 1: if transfer is to a higher band but promotion denied later, do we revert comp?

Evan R.: we avoid giving level/title changes without calibration. If comp-only change was made for retention concurrent with transfer, clearly mark it as `comp-only` in the CompChange form. If promotion denied later, we do not retroactively remove previously paid compensation; exceptions require documented exec approval and a clear employee agreement.

Jordan L.: got it. Action items: 1) manager to submit Transfer form + Promotion packet (mark transfer effective date), 2) request expedited calibration if needed, 3) comp to review and confirm payroll cutoff/proration, 4) benefits to confirm enrollments.

Maya P.: will submit now. Thanks! :thumbsup:
